messages.subject: package installation of rgdal on a Mac
parts:
Hi,
I am having problems installing rgdal in R Studio on my Mac.
Does anyone have any tips?
I found this possible solution but I have had no luck downloading GDAL- all the files I download seems to be made for Windows as they aren't downloading like Mac files.
http://grokbase.com/t/r/r-sig-geo/12c4pmrf0d/rgdal-problem-in-r-studio
Thanks

messages.author: f8f554f3c8aec296
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: package installation of rgdal on a Mac
parts:
There's some overhead (in the form of system requirements) for installing source packages. 

Package managers (I've had good luck on Mac using homebrew for gdal) can help. You may also need to first install OS x developer tools if you haven't already

- Jaime
